programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Sementara beberapa anggota keluarga memperlakukannya dengan baik, yang lain terus-menerus menghina dan meremehkannya.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Nada Dan Dakwah
programme.desc: The people of Pandanwangi village suddenly became anxious when they heard the news that the land where they lived would be bought by a conglomerate. The conflict spread beyond the issue of land to include moral issues with the establishment of drinking establishments and billiard halls.

programme.title: The Doll 3
programme.desc: After being possessed by the spirit of her late brother, a wicked doll terrorizes a woman and her loved ones.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: A jester is accidentally recruited by a cult leader to spy on a young and inexperienced Chinese emperor. Things don't go according to plan, and he ends up working for multiple opposing sides while trying to survive the madness.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father is exposed.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: A model (Joey Wong) gets raped by a photographer (Wilson Lam). Meanwhile, she falls out with her best friend (Carol Cheng) due to her boyfriend (Alex Man), who's a cop.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Best friends Bodil and Isabel, apparently happily married, sneak off for secret affairs using each other as an alibi. But when Isabel is killed when they were supposed to have been together. Bodil gets caught up in her own web of lies.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: In 1920s China, a bandit arrives in a remote provincial town posing as its new mayor, where he faces off against a tyrannical local nobleman.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: The story is about a powerful drug-lord in southeast Asia, and the good guys have to save their loved ones under the threat of the Drug business conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. programme.title: Smurfs

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings

programme.title: Quantum Heroes Dinoster

Petualangan Mereka Dibantu Oleh Seorang Ilmuwan Kuantum Yaitu Professor Laura. programme.title: Boboiboy Galaxy

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Lensa Indonesia Malam

programme.title: Ijin, Ndan !
programme.desc: Ijin, Ndan Adalah Program Crimetainment Yang Menggabungkan Informasi Seputar Kejahatan Dan Kriminalitas Dengan Sketsa Komedi Situasional Yang Berlatar Di Ruang Interogasi Atau Kantor Polisi. Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. Dengan Gaya Penyajian Yang Ringan, Menghibur, Dan Penuh Humor, Ijin, Ndan Tetap Konsisten Menyampaikan Fakta Aktual Dan Pesan Edukatif Kepada Penonton, Menjadikannya Tontonan Yang Informatif Sekaligus Mengundang Tawa.

programme.title: Abrakadabra

programme.desc: Kanaya (Sandrinna Michelle) seorang gadis remaja yang populer di sekolah, namun di rumah ia hanyalah seorang kakak yang harus menjaga adiknya, Alisa (Giselle Irene), apalagi Alisa yang memutuskan untuk sekolah bersama Kanaya. Tidak hanya itu, di sekolah Kanaya harus berhadapan dengan cinta pertamanya Arga (Andy William) dan Dastan (Lazuardy Nasution), anak baru yang tengil di sekolah. Bagaimanakah nasib Kanaya selanjutnya? Sakiskan SINETRON TERBARU SEINDAH MASA REMAJA
